info.title: dubstack Admin API
info.description: Server-side API for triggering documentation deployments and workflows, creating branch previews, retrieving published documentation, and exporting organization analytics, including aggregate assistant caller activity. Every operation requires a scoped Admin API key.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Deployment update, preview, and status operations.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Tenant-scoped usage, feedback, traffic, visitor, search, and assistant caller reporting.

tags.name: Content
tags.description: Deployment-scoped published documentation search and page retrieval.

post.description: Queue a live deployment update from the configured deployment branch. Requires the deployments:trigger Admin API key scope.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: The deployment site ID. Site-scoped keys can only use their assigned site.

401.description: Admin API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: Admin API key is not allowed to perform this action.

404.description: Requested site or deployment was not found.

409.description: The site is not ready for deployment updates.

post.description: Create or refresh a preview deployment for a Git branch. Requires the deployments:trigger Admin API key scope.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: The deployment site ID. Site-scoped keys can only use their assigned site.

400.description: The branch value is missing or invalid.

401.description: Admin API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: Admin API key is not allowed to perform this action.

404.description: Requested site or deployment was not found.

409.description: The site or branch is not ready for preview deployments.

get.description: Read deployment status and logs by status ID. Requires either deployments:read or deployments:trigger.

parameters.name: statusId
parameters.description: The deployment status ID returned by a deployment trigger endpoint.

401.description: Admin API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: Admin API key is not allowed to perform this action.

404.description: Requested site or deployment was not found.

post.description: Queue an enabled workflow run from trusted backend automation. Requires the workflows:run Admin API key scope. Only workflows configured with the Custom schedule trigger are API-triggerable.

parameters.name: workflowId
parameters.description: Built-in workflow ID, custom_workflow for the saved custom workflow configuration, or custom_workflow:{id} for a specific user-created custom workflow.

400.description: The request is missing a required site_id for an unscoped key or contains invalid input.

401.description: Admin API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: Admin API key does not have the workflows:run scope or is not scoped to the requested deployment.

404.description: Workflow, custom workflow, or site was not found.

409.description: Workflow is not ready to run, is not API-triggerable, already has an active run, or the runner is unavailable.

500.description: Workflow run could not be queued.

get.description: Read retrieval activity and AI usage accounting for a site-scoped or organization-scoped Admin API key. Requires the analytics:read scope.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Rolling window length in days. Ignored when from and to are supplied.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start calendar date for the export window in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End calendar date for the export window in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: timezoneOffsetMinutes
parameters.description: Timezone offset used when calculating local reporting days.

parameters.name: site_id
parameters.description: Deployment site ID. Required only when the Admin API key is organization-scoped and the export should be limited to one deployment.

parameters.name: site_slug
parameters.description: Deployment slug alternative to site_id for organization-scoped keys.

parameters.name: subdomain
parameters.description: Published dubstack.live subdomain alternative to site_id for organization-scoped keys.

401.description: Admin API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: Admin API key is not allowed to read this analytics scope.

500.description: Usage analytics could not be exported.

post.description: Search one deployment's published searchable index and return bounded ranked snippets. Requires the content:read Admin API key scope.

parameters.name: site_id
parameters.description: Deployment site ID. Supply exactly one site selector when using an organization-scoped key. Omit for site-scoped keys.

parameters.name: site_slug
parameters.description: Deployment slug. Supply exactly one site selector when using an organization-scoped key. Omit for site-scoped keys.

parameters.name: subdomain
parameters.description: Deployment subdomain. Supply exactly one site selector when using an organization-scoped key. Omit for site-scoped keys.

400.description: The query, page size, or organization-level site selector is invalid.

401.description: Admin API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: Admin API key does not include content:read or cannot access the selected deployment.

409.description: The deployment has no published documentation source configured.

post.description: Return the full Markdown or MDX body for a page in one deployment's published searchable index. Requires the content:read Admin API key scope.

parameters.name: site_id
parameters.description: Deployment site ID. Supply exactly one site selector when using an organization-scoped key. Omit for site-scoped keys.

parameters.name: site_slug
parameters.description: Deployment slug. Supply exactly one site selector when using an organization-scoped key. Omit for site-scoped keys.

parameters.name: subdomain
parameters.description: Deployment subdomain. Supply exactly one site selector when using an organization-scoped key. Omit for site-scoped keys.

200.description: Published page content and public metadata.

400.description: The page path or organization-level site selector is invalid.

401.description: Admin API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: Admin API key does not include content:read or cannot access the selected deployment.

404.description: Selected deployment or indexed page was not found.

409.description: The deployment has no published documentation source configured.

AdminApiBearer.description: Server-side Admin API key created from Settings > Security > API keys.

projectId.description: Alias for siteId for API compatibility.

trigger_source.description: Source that queued the run. Admin API triggered runs use api.

trigger_type.description: Workflow trigger type used for this run.

update_mode.description: How the workflow is allowed to apply output.

site_id.description: Deployment site ID. Required only when the Admin API key is organization-scoped instead of site-scoped.

query.description: Natural-language or keyword query for the selected deployment.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of ranked results to return.

content.description: Bounded relevant excerpt from the published page.

path.description: Public path of the matching documentation page.

score.description: Relative relevance score. Compare scores within this response; the value is not normalized to a fixed range.

path.description: Published page path. URLs, query strings, fragments, traversal segments, and dotfile paths are rejected.
Canonical public path of the indexed page.

content.description: Full Markdown or MDX page body without frontmatter.

status.description: Recorded outcome for the assistant requests in this aggregate.

callerType.description: Interaction channel such as public_assistant or dashboard_assistant. This is not a person or user identifier.
